As we approach Christmas we are going through very exciting times at Capstar.
We have taken on new Chauffeurs, are launching Capstar Aviation and looking
forward to 2015, which remarkably will be our third calendar year! We were so
proud in November to have received the three trophies from the QSI
Professional Driver Awards ceremonies and are looking to add to these next year.
From all at Capstar, we wish you a very Happy Christmas and here is to a great
start in the New Year!
